target_statement: For every finite nonabelian simple group L and every conjugacy class D of involutions in L, every permutation of D preserving the order |ab| for each pair of distinct vertices a,b is induced on D by an automorphism of L that stabilizes D setwise.

source_clauses.text: Let L be a finite non-abelian simple group, and let D be a conjugacy class of involutions in L.
On the complete graph Gamma with vertex set D, two edges (a,b) and (c,d) have the same colour if and only if |ab|=|cd|.
A colour-graph automorphism is a permutation tau of D satisfying (a,b)~(a^tau,b^tau) for every edge (a,b).
Is the automorphism group of the coloured graph Gamma a subgroup of Aut(L)?

constraints.statement: The assertion quantifies over every pair (L,D) satisfying the remaining admissibility rows.
L is a finite nonabelian simple group.
D is one conjugacy class in L and every member of D has order exactly 2.
Gamma is the complete simple graph with vertex set D, so its edges are unordered pairs of distinct elements of D.
The colour of edge {a,b} is determined exactly by the element order |ab| in L; two edges have the same colour exactly when these orders are equal.
tau is a permutation of D such that |ab|=|a^tau b^tau| for every two distinct a,b in D.
Every such tau is the restriction to D of an automorphism of L that stabilizes D setwise; this is the typed meaning of Aut(Gamma)<=Aut(L) in the source.
